shell_commands:
git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.coerceError.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(orchestrator): call onError for non-Error rejections

Wrap non-Error rejections in Error instances with readable messages
while preserving the original value as the cause. This ensures onError
hooks are always fired for any rejection, not just Error instances,
so deployers can correctly count and alert on all failures.

The re-thrown value at the caller boundary remains unchanged.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
